analysis.summaryJa: 主節を主映像とすると、分詞構文の-ing句は同じ動作主による同時動作、文頭の背景・時、または主節から生じた結果を別トラックとして加える。明示しない限り-ingの動作主は主節主語と一致させる。
grammarPoints: 文末-ingによる同時の付帯動作
文頭-ingによる背景・時の設定
カンマ＋-ingによる主節の結果
while＋-ingによる同時性と懸垂分詞の回避
visualEvidence: 画像のMAIN TRACKと-ING TRACKが並行し、同時・背景・結果の読みを示す
文頭はscene setting、文末はadded detail/resultという配置ガイドがある
Walking down the street, the rain startedの動作主不一致が警告される
commonTraps: 文頭-ingの動作主を主節主語と不一致にする
結果の-ingを意図・目的と誤解する
whileの後ろに主語なしの過去形を置く
主節と-ing句の論理関係を語順だけで決める

questions.prompt: The receptionist greeted each visitor, ------- their names on a tablet.

choices.A: checked
choices.B: to check
choices.C: checking

questions.translationJa: 受付係は各来訪者に挨拶しながら、タブレットで名前を確認しました。
questions.explanationJa: checkingは主節主語receptionistの同時動作を文末に加えます。

questions.prompt: ------- the morning mail, Mr. Boyd noticed an unsigned form.

choices.A: Opening
choices.B: Opened
choices.C: To opened

questions.translationJa: 朝の郵便物を開封していて、ボイドさんは未署名の用紙に気付きました。
questions.explanationJa: Opening句は主節主語Mr. Boydの背景場面を文頭で示します。

questions.prompt: The server failed overnight, ------- online orders for two hours.

choices.A: delayed
choices.B: to delay
choices.C: delay

questions.translationJa: サーバーが夜間に故障し、その結果オンライン注文が2時間遅れました。
questions.explanationJa: delayingはサーバー故障から生じた結果を表します。

questions.prompt: While ------- for the client, the consultant reviewed the agenda.

choices.A: waited
choices.B: waiting
choices.C: to wait

questions.translationJa: 顧客を待つ間、コンサルタントは議題を確認しました。
questions.explanationJa: while waitingは主節主語consultantの同時の時間背景です。

questions.prompt: ------- the safety checklist, the inspector entered the storage area.

choices.A: Carrying
choices.B: Carried
choices.C: To carried

questions.translationJa: 安全チェックリストを持ちながら、検査員は保管区域に入りました。
questions.explanationJa: Carryingの動作主は直後の主節主語the inspectorです。

questions.prompt: The automatic door closed suddenly, ------- a delivery cart outside.

choices.A: left
choices.B: to leave
choices.C: leaving

questions.translationJa: 自動ドアが突然閉まり、その結果、配送カートが外に取り残されました。
questions.explanationJa: leaving句はドアが閉じた結果を追加します。

questions.prompt: Ms. Flores walked through the warehouse ------- notes about each aisle.

choices.A: took
choices.B: taking
choices.C: to took

questions.translationJa: フローレスさんは各通路についてメモを取りながら倉庫内を歩きました。
questions.explanationJa: taking notesは主節主語の同時進行動作です。

questions.prompt: ------- the updated map, the driver found the temporary entrance.

choices.A: Followed
choices.B: To followed
choices.C: Follow

questions.translationJa: 更新地図に従い、運転手は仮入口を見つけました。
questions.explanationJa: Following句が方法・背景を先に提示し、動作主driverと一致します。

questions.prompt: The price was entered incorrectly, ------- the invoice total to increase.

choices.A: caused
choices.B: to cause
choices.C: causing

questions.translationJa: 価格が誤って入力され、その結果、請求書合計が増加しました。
questions.explanationJa: causingは主節全体の結果を表し、cause＋目的語＋to doの内部構造も保ちます。

questions.prompt: While ------- the equipment, technicians must wear gloves.

choices.A: handled
choices.B: to handle
choices.C: handle

questions.translationJa: 機器を扱う間、技術者は手袋を着用しなければなりません。
questions.explanationJa: handlingの動作主は主節主語techniciansで、whileが同時性を明示します。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence with the same person doing both actions.

choices.A: The clerk walked to the counter, the documents carrying him.
choices.B: The clerk walked to the counter carrying the documents.
choices.C: Carrying the documents, the counter approached the clerk.
choices.D: The clerk carrying walked the documents to the counter.

questions.translationJa: 係員は書類を運びながら窓口まで歩きました。
questions.explanationJa: walkedとcarryingの動作主はいずれもthe clerkです。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence setting a scene at the beginning.

choices.A: Checking the reservation list, a duplicate name surprised Maya found.
choices.B: Checked the reservation list, Maya finding a duplicate name.
choices.C: Checking the reservation list, a duplicate name found Maya.
choices.D: Checking the reservation list, Maya found a duplicate name.

questions.translationJa: 予約一覧を確認していて、マヤは重複した名前を見つけました。
questions.explanationJa: Checkingの動作主は主節主語Mayaで、文頭が背景場面を作ります。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence in which -ing expresses a result.

choices.A: The pipe burst, flooding the storage room.
choices.B: The pipe burst, flooded the storage room.
choices.C: Flooding the storage room, the manager heard the pipe.
choices.D: The pipe flooding, the storage room burst.

questions.translationJa: 配管が破裂し、その結果、保管室が水浸しになりました。
questions.explanationJa: floodingは配管破裂による結果をカンマ後で示します。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence with while and a shared subject.

choices.A: While speaking with the customer, the account file opened the agent.
choices.B: While spoke with the customer, the agent opened the account file.
choices.C: While speaking with the customer, the agent opened the account file.
choices.D: While the agent speaking, opened the customer the file.

questions.translationJa: 顧客と話しながら、担当者はアカウントファイルを開きました。
questions.explanationJa: while speakingの省略主語は主節主語agentです。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence without a dangling participle.

choices.A: Walking through the lobby, a damaged tile caught my eye itself.
choices.B: Walking through the lobby, the lights were bright.
choices.C: Walking through the lobby, there was a damaged tile.
choices.D: Walking through the lobby, I noticed a damaged tile.

questions.translationJa: ロビーを歩いていて、私は損傷したタイルに気付きました。
questions.explanationJa: Walkingの動作主が明示された主節主語Iと一致します。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence adding a natural final detail.

choices.A: The presenter answered questions, referred occasionally to her notes.
choices.B: The presenter answered questions, referring occasionally to her notes.
choices.C: Referring to her notes, the questions answered the presenter.
choices.D: The presenter referring answered questions her notes.

questions.translationJa: 発表者は時折メモを参照しながら質問に答えました。
questions.explanationJa: referring句はpresenterの同時の付加動作です。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence where the -ing phrase gives the consequence.

choices.A: Demand increased sharply, forced the factory adding a shift.
choices.B: Forcing the factory, a shift increased demand sharply.
choices.C: Demand increased sharply, forcing the factory to add a shift.
choices.D: Demand forcing sharply increased the factory shift.

questions.translationJa: 需要が急増し、そのため工場はシフトを追加せざるを得ませんでした。
questions.explanationJa: forcing以下は需要増加が引き起こした結果です。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence placing focus on the opening scene.

choices.A: Entering the quiet office, Mr. Price heard an alarm.
choices.B: Entering the quiet office, an alarm heard Mr. Price.
choices.C: Entered the quiet office, Mr. Price hearing an alarm.
choices.D: Entering, the quiet office Mr. Price heard was an alarm.

questions.translationJa: 静かな事務所に入ると、プライスさんは警報音を聞きました。
questions.explanationJa: 文頭Entering句はMr. Priceの行動場面を先に示します。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence linking simultaneous actions with while.

choices.A: While reviewed the contract, Ms. Bell highlighted two clauses.
choices.B: While reviewing the contract, two clauses highlighted Ms. Bell.
choices.C: While the contract reviewing, Ms. Bell two clauses highlighted.
choices.D: While reviewing the contract, Ms. Bell highlighted two clauses.

questions.translationJa: 契約書を確認しながら、ベルさんは2つの条項を強調表示しました。
questions.explanationJa: reviewingとhighlightedの動作主がMs. Bellで一致します。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence whose logic makes the final -ing a result.

choices.A: The shipment missed the flight, delayed delivery until Monday.
choices.B: Delaying the shipment, Monday missed the flight.
choices.C: The shipment missed the flight, delaying delivery until Monday.
choices.D: The delivery missing, the flight delayed Monday.

questions.translationJa: 配送品が便に間に合わず、その結果、配送は月曜日まで遅れました。
questions.explanationJa: delivery delayは便に間に合わなかった結果として自然です。
questions.focus: 論理から判断する結果-ing

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: "The assistant entered smiling."

choices.A: The assistant entered after she stopped smiling.
choices.B: Someone smiled at the assistant’s entrance.
choices.C: The assistant made the door smile.

questions.translationJa: アシスタントは微笑みながら入ってきました。
questions.explanationJa: 文末smilingは主節と同じ人の同時動作です。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: "Opening the file, I found an error."

choices.A: The file opened me after finding an error.
choices.B: When I opened the file, I found an error.
choices.C: An error opened the file by itself.
choices.D: I found no error before closing the file.

questions.translationJa: ファイルを開くと、私はエラーを見つけました。
questions.explanationJa: 文頭Opening句はwhen節に展開できる時間・背景です。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: "The alarm sounded, waking everyone."

choices.A: Everyone sounded the alarm after waking.
choices.B: The alarm fell asleep with everyone.
choices.C: The alarm sounded, and as a result everyone woke up.
choices.D: Everyone woke before any alarm sounded.

questions.translationJa: 警報が鳴り、その結果、全員が目を覚ましました。
questions.explanationJa: waking everyoneは警報音の結果を示します。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: "While waiting for approval, we revised the budget."

choices.A: We revised the budget during the time we waited for approval.
choices.B: Approval revised the budget before we waited.
choices.C: We stopped waiting after rejecting the budget.

questions.translationJa: 承認を待つ間に予算を修正しました。
questions.explanationJa: while waitingが主節と同時の時間範囲を示します。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: "Carrying a laptop, Elena boarded the train."

choices.A: A laptop boarded the train carrying Elena.
choices.B: Elena carried a laptop as she boarded the train.
choices.C: Elena left the laptop before boarding.
choices.D: The train carried only the laptop.

questions.translationJa: エレナはノートパソコンを持って列車に乗りました。
questions.explanationJa: carryingの動作主は主節主語Elenaです。
questions.focus: 共有動作主の同時動作

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: "Sales fell, leading management to revise the forecast."

choices.A: Management revised sales to increase the fall.
choices.B: The forecast caused sales to fall later.
choices.C: Sales rose after management kept the forecast.
choices.D: Because sales fell, management revised the forecast.

questions.translationJa: 売上が減少したため、経営陣は予測を修正しました。
questions.explanationJa: leading以下は売上減少が引き起こした結果を表します。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: "Looking at the map, the driver found the entrance."

choices.A: The driver found the entrance while looking at the map.
choices.B: The map found the driver at the entrance.
choices.C: The entrance looked at the driver.
choices.D: The driver discarded the map before searching.

questions.translationJa: 運転手は地図を見ながら入口を見つけました。
questions.explanationJa: lookingとfoundの動作主はdriverで、同時の背景です。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: "The price rose, causing several orders to be canceled."

choices.A: Canceled orders caused the price to fall.
choices.B: The price was canceled by several orders.
choices.C: Several orders were canceled as a result of the price rise.
choices.D: Every order increased the price intentionally.

questions.translationJa: 価格上昇の結果、複数の注文がキャンセルされました。
questions.explanationJa: causing句は主節から生じた因果結果を示します。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: "While inspecting the room, the manager took photos."

choices.A: The manager took photos during the inspection of the room.
choices.B: The room took photos of the manager.
choices.C: The manager inspected photos instead of the room.

questions.translationJa: 部長は部屋を検査しながら写真を撮りました。
questions.explanationJa: while inspectingは同じ主語managerの並行動作です。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: "A storm closed the airport, stranding hundreds of travelers."

choices.A: Travelers closed the airport before the storm.
choices.B: Hundreds of travelers were stranded because the storm closed the airport.
choices.C: The storm helped travelers leave early.
choices.D: The airport stranded the storm outside.

questions.translationJa: 嵐で空港が閉鎖され、数百人の旅行者が足止めされました。
questions.explanationJa: strandingは空港閉鎖の結果を表します。

questions.prompt: The receptionist moved through the line. She checked each badge, ------- visitors toward the elevators.

choices.A: directed
choices.B: to direct
choices.C: directing

questions.translationJa: 受付係は列に沿って移動しました。各バッジを確認しながら、来訪者をエレベーターへ案内しました。
questions.explanationJa: directingは同じ主語sheの同時動作を追加します。

questions.prompt: Ms. Ito opened the shipment. ------- the contents, she noticed a missing cable.

choices.A: Examining
choices.B: Examined
choices.C: To examined

questions.translationJa: 伊藤さんは配送品を開けました。中身を調べていて、ケーブル不足に気付きました。
questions.explanationJa: Examiningの動作主は主節主語sheです。

questions.prompt: The cooling system stopped overnight. This raised the temperature, ------- several samples.

choices.A: damaged
choices.B: to damage
choices.C: damage

questions.translationJa: 冷却システムが夜間に停止しました。そのため温度が上がり、複数のサンプルが損傷しました。
questions.explanationJa: damagingは温度上昇の結果を示します。

questions.prompt: The consultant had twenty minutes before the call. While -------, she reviewed the client’s questions.

choices.A: waited
choices.B: waiting
choices.C: to wait

questions.translationJa: コンサルタントは電話まで20分ありました。待つ間に顧客の質問を確認しました。
questions.explanationJa: while waitingは主節主語sheの同時の時間背景です。

questions.prompt: The driver was holding a route sheet. ------- it closely, he located the new warehouse.

choices.A: Followed
choices.B: To followed
choices.C: Following

questions.translationJa: 運転手は経路表を持っていました。それに注意深く従い、新しい倉庫を見つけました。
questions.explanationJa: Followingの動作主はheで、方法背景を文頭に置きます。

questions.prompt: A truck blocked the only entrance, ------- the morning delivery.

choices.A: delaying
choices.B: delayed
choices.C: to delay

questions.translationJa: トラックが唯一の入口をふさぎ、その結果、朝の配送が遅れました。
questions.explanationJa: delayingはblockした結果を示します。

questions.prompt: The inspector walked along every aisle ------- shelf numbers.

choices.A: recorded
choices.B: recording
choices.C: to record

questions.translationJa: 検査員は棚番号を記録しながら各通路を歩きました。
questions.explanationJa: recordingはinspectorの同時動作です。

questions.prompt: The visitors were unfamiliar with the building. While ------- to the hall, they followed the blue signs.

choices.A: walked
choices.B: to walk
choices.C: walk

questions.translationJa: 来訪者は建物に不慣れでした。ホールへ歩く間、青い標識に従いました。
questions.explanationJa: walkingとfollowedの動作主はtheyで一致します。

questions.prompt: The board rejected the first proposal, ------- the team to prepare a new one.

choices.A: requiring
choices.B: required
choices.C: to require

questions.translationJa: 取締役会は最初の提案を却下し、その結果、チームは新案の作成を求められました。
questions.explanationJa: requiringは却下から生じた結果で、require＋人＋to doの形です。

questions.prompt: The employee wanted to catch the first train. ------- the office, she checked that every door was locked.

choices.A: Left
choices.B: Leaving
choices.C: To left

questions.translationJa: 従業員は始発列車に乗りたがっていました。事務所を出る際、すべてのドアが施錠されているか確認しました。
questions.explanationJa: Leavingの動作主sheが主節主語と一致し、退出場面を先に示します。
questions.focus: 文頭場面設定と動作主
